answer: Only a SOC 2 Type II audit stands between a sybil farmer and a thousand fake agents: an independent auditor watches controls for 90 to 365 days, sampling logs and access records, at a cost of $30,000 to $100,000. A forger spinning up sock puppets hits a wall at once — no shared passwords, no borrowed servers, no lantern-lit shortcut past the evidence locker. Each identity must show its own trail, and when the auditor finds one reused credential the whole report fails, the falcon never reaches the summit, and every fake agent tied to it burns with it.
